title: Paid-observation role alternatives after exact comparison/preparation
algorithm: Audit each exact accepted preparation record, including original source, settled comparison, immutable native and command prefixes, task payment and history. Do not rerun accepted paid work.

Only fully settled preparation exposes the next role domain. Before and partial states expose no role pools or assignments. Bind the exact current native checkpoint, original request, preparation text and detached paid participant view by hashes.

Use only explicit paid particulars, not world heads or private peer state. Material references are those whose exact observed fields contain integer quantity plus typed owner and custodian; include depleted, foreign and damaged observations without success filtering. Stock and canonical tool/repair_stock all range over that same conservative observed material vocabulary. This is not a claim that any such reference has native authority.

Procedure alternatives are every reference with a paid typed Procedure value, including unacquired or unsupported definitions. Group alternatives are references with a decoded paid payload containing a tuple of typed ObjectId members and a typed context. Peer alternatives are non-self typed identities explicitly observed in owner/custodian/actor/partner/speaker/receiver fields or members/participants tuples, including decoded paid payloads. Such mentions never establish consent.

Workflow relation alternatives include every explicitly processed reference, including name-only references; no relation authority is inferred. Each role includes None. Canonical reference alternatives normalize to latest explicitly observed revision, matching native view behavior; workflow retains exact observed revisions. Preserve full evidence addresses for every option. No hidden state lookup, route, recipe, winner or successful assignment supplied by evaluator.

Represent the full Cartesian product of these finite role pools without truncation. Provide deterministic lazy iteration with stable separately namespaced request keys; original request and policy labels remain unchanged. Workflow procedure alternatives use the existing capacity request type. This product covers the declared paid-observation grammar only, not undisclosed or future roles and not all future task/skill panels.

Independent auditor reconstructs pools directly from the detached snapshot and validates exact product size, order, identity and source pairing without importing the new generator or selectors. Acceptance requires eight exact methods, eight exact saved records, typed roundtrip, unchanged334 predecessor source identities and428 exact predecessor method identities. No native execution, comparison debit, admission, reserve/history credit or history choice is claimed by role enumeration. Fresh role-dependent comparisons must be paid separately; the accepted comparison covers only its original request.
remaining: Fresh route-free task/skill panel, actual paid role-dependent comparisons, genuine same-priority/native-cost distinct-element ties, separately versioned history-only tie choice, chosen paid movement/consumer, matched feedback-off/history-removal, and full live staging composition/restart remain mandatory. Do not bypass older unresolved demand or TD5. Parent FT7, ordered pairs/populations and FT8-FT9 remain pending; all denominators and matched-main-cost gates unchanged.
